units.nominal_test_size: USD equivalent from separately clocked unpinned public API

simulation_clock.basis: Historical original evidence pin reused; later collection is not a new latest-state observation.

fees_at_financial_pin.basis: Separate fee layers and bases; percentages must not simply be added. Exact deployed fee-formula correspondence remains bounded.

standardized_exit.method: Independent funded ordinary withdrawal eth_call and call trace; no state override or transaction
standardized_exit.route: Outer wrapper withdrawal redeems strategy inner ERC4626 claim and delivers underlying WETH; receipt redemption alone is not the cash endpoint.

additional_standardized_sizes.status: Not funded/tested: exceeds whole-wrapper capitalization at the evidence pin; not a demonstrated liquidity failure
Not funded/tested: exceeds whole-wrapper capitalization at the evidence pin; not a demonstrated liquidity failure

liquidity_perimeter: Wrapper underlying claim is already within the direct vault; wrapper TVL is not additional underlying capital
Direct and wrapper exits use shared underlying market cash; capacities are not additive
A successful pinned sample does not reserve cash or establish future/stressed maximum capacity

confidence_limits: Exact Beefy/adapter/registry source and complete role/pending/audit-build assurance incomplete
Six-hour strategy replacement view does not prove beaconupgrade delay
No independently comparable wrapper realized investor PPS/reward/fee/gas history

limits: Pinned simulation is not executed settlement or a future liquidity guarantee
Source/runtime, beacon, full roles/pending, audit and comparable investor-return assurance remain bounded
Oracle source/writer/origin/heartbeat and independent secondary basis are not cleared by the exit result

nominal_usd_reference.source: Original public API, not on-chain pinned price or executable sale quote
nominal_usd_reference.scope: Used only to select standardized nominal USD test size; exact WETH payout is separately pinned.
